messages.使用方法：① 在上方选择要展示的特征和实验组。② 在“两分布比较”中分别指定 A: How to use: ① Select the features and experimental groups to be displayed above. ② In "Comparison of Two Distributions", specify the characteristics and experimental groups of A and B respectively, select Welch or Mann-Whitney and click "Run Comparison of Two Distributions". Matching the same feature with two experimental groups allows you to compare differences between groups; pairing two features with the same experimental group allows you to compare the strengths of the two features in the group. ③ Image selection method: Open scatter points, hold down Shift and continuously click any cell point in the two distributions, or use box selection/lasso to circle the two distributions, then click "Fill the two selected distributions into the comparison column", and then run the comparison. The test uses all valid cells of the selected distribution; inclusion of zero values ​​is determined by Use Zero Values ​​for Targeted Analysis. Use comparable intensity scales when comparing across features. "Additional Two-Two Group Tests" adds multiple group comparisons, using the tests specified by "Two Distribution Test Methods". Asterisks correspond to raw p values: * ≤ 0.05, ** ≤ 0.01, *** ≤ 0.001, **** ≤ 0.0001; ns means p > 0.05.
